verdict.rationale: First-party docs directly document exposing a sandbox port and getting a public preview URL to reach services inside. A dedicated ports API with request routing supports this, plus an alternative zero-config tunnels.get(port) path on *.trycloudflare.com URLs. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of preview URLs working in practice.
